description: Score a company against your ideal customer profile (ICP) using weighted signals. Returns a 0 to 100 icp_score, an A to D icp_tier, and a per-signal breakdown as a flat, Clay-ready JSON row. Define your ICP with a template, scoring_config, or plain-English icp_description (which requires llm_api_key). Read-only; requires an APIFY_TOKEN and consumes Apify credits per call.

company_domain.description: The primary domain of the company to score, e.g. clay.com

company_name.description: Optional display name of the company.

crm_detected.description: Whether any CRM was detected. Accepts a boolean-like string ("true"/"false") or any non-empty CRM name (e.g. "Salesforce"). Sent as a string for Clay compatibility and coerced to boolean at runtime. Auto-derived from uses_hubspot/uses_salesforce if not set.

employee_band.description: Firmographic employee band from the Company Firmographic Enricher (Actor ID YlUtLWjfPpqykmB8g), e.g. "201-500". Scores via employee_band_match when it is in target_employee_bands.

fetch_signals.description: If true, the actor fetches hiring and tech-stack signals automatically before scoring.

founded_year.description: Year the company was founded, from the Company Firmographic Enricher (Actor ID YlUtLWjfPpqykmB8g). Carried for reference; not currently scored. Accepts a numeric string (e.g. "2015").

funded_within_days.description: Optional. How recent a funding round must be to count for the recently_funded signal, in days. Defaults to 540 (18 months).

funding_stage.description: Funding stage (e.g. seed, series_a, series_b, growth). Used to infer recently_funded.

gtm_hiring_signal.description: Whether the company is actively hiring for GTM/sales roles. Accepts a boolean-like string ("true"/"false"). Sent as a string for Clay compatibility and coerced to boolean at runtime.

gtm_role_count.description: Number of open GTM/sales roles. Scores via the gtm_role_count_strong signal when at or above min_gtm_roles (default 2). Accepts a numeric string (e.g. "8"). Sent as a string for Clay compatibility and coerced to integer at runtime.

has_linkedin.description: Whether a company LinkedIn page was found, from the Company Social Presence Mapper (Actor ID 4k6CCemkgBDz18m2h) or the Domain to LinkedIn URL Resolver (Actor ID 3HtnSaqPHOg1Qg5gx). Contributes to social_presence. Accepts a boolean-like string.

has_twitter.description: Whether a company X/Twitter profile was found, from the Company Social Presence Mapper (Actor ID 4k6CCemkgBDz18m2h). Contributes to social_presence. Accepts a boolean-like string.

headcount.description: Current employee headcount. Accepts a numeric string (e.g. "3000"). Sent as a string for Clay compatibility and coerced to integer at runtime.

headcount_in_range.description: Override: whether headcount is in your target range.

headcount_max.description: Maximum headcount for the headcount_in_range signal.

headcount_min.description: Minimum headcount for the headcount_in_range signal.

hq_location.description: Headquarters location from the Company Firmographic Enricher (Actor ID YlUtLWjfPpqykmB8g). Carried for reference; not currently scored.

include_explanation.description: If true, adds a score_explanation string to the output.

industry.description: The company's industry (from the Company Firmographic Enricher, Actor ID YlUtLWjfPpqykmB8g).

industry_match.description: Override: whether the company's industry matches your target list.

job_count.description: Number of open jobs found, from the Job Board Keyword Signal Scanner (Actor ID 4DvqpvhMR74NLcDDY). Scores via active_hiring_volume when at or above min_job_count (default 3). Accepts a numeric string.

keyword_match_count.description: Number of target-keyword matches found, from the Job Board Keyword Signal Scanner (Actor ID 4DvqpvhMR74NLcDDY). Scores via keyword_signal_match when at or above min_keyword_matches (default 1). Accepts a numeric string.

last_funding_date.description: ISO date of last funding round (legacy field; latest_funding_date is preferred). Used to auto-detect recently_funded if the boolean is not set.

latest_funding_amount.description: Dollar amount of the latest funding round (from C1 when it ships). Scores via well_funded when at or above min_funding_amount (default 1000000). Accepts a numeric string (e.g. "50000000").

latest_funding_date.description: ISO date of the latest funding round (from C1 Funding & Press Signal Scanner when it ships). Drives recently_funded against funded_within_days.

llm_api_key.description: Your OpenAI or Anthropic key, used only with icp_description.

llm_provider.description: LLM provider for icp_description: openai or anthropic.

min_score_to_output.description: If set, rows scoring below this threshold are skipped from output (not pushed to dataset). Skipped rows are logged only.

previous_score.description: Previous ICP score for this company. If provided, output includes score_change and score_trend fields.

recently_funded.description: Override: whether the company was recently funded (within funded_within_days, default 540).

revenue_estimate.description: Estimated annual revenue in dollars from the Company Firmographic Enricher (Actor ID YlUtLWjfPpqykmB8g). Scores via revenue_in_range. Accepts a numeric string (e.g. "50000000"). Coerced to integer at runtime.

seq_tool_detected.description: Whether a sales sequencing tool (Outreach, SalesLoft, Apollo, Lemlist) was detected. Accepts a boolean-like string ("true"/"false") or any non-empty tool name (e.g. "Outreach"). Sent as a string for Clay compatibility and coerced to boolean at runtime.

social_platforms_found.description: Number of official social platforms found, from the Company Social Presence Mapper (Actor ID 4k6CCemkgBDz18m2h). Scores via social_presence when at or above min_social_platforms (default 2). Accepts a numeric string.

target_industries.description: Comma-separated list of target industries for the industry_match signal.

tech_stack.description: Comma-separated list of technologies. Used to auto-detect CRM/sequencing tools if booleans are not set.

template.description: Name of a prebuilt scoring config.

tier_thresholds.description: Optional. Minimum score for each tier as { "tier_a": number, "tier_b": number, "tier_c": number }. Scores at or above tier_a are A, tier_b are B, tier_c are C, else D. Defaults to 80 / 60 / 40.

total_followers.description: Total social followers across platforms, from the Company Social Presence Mapper (Actor ID 4k6CCemkgBDz18m2h). Scores via strong_social_following when at or above min_total_followers (default 1000). Accepts a numeric string.

uses_clay.description: Whether the company uses Clay. Accepts a boolean-like string ("true"/"false"). Sent as a string for Clay compatibility and coerced to boolean at runtime.

uses_hubspot.description: Whether the company uses HubSpot. Accepts a boolean-like string ("true"/"false"). Sent as a string for Clay compatibility and coerced to boolean at runtime.

uses_salesforce.description: Whether the company uses Salesforce. Accepts a boolean-like string ("true"/"false"). Sent as a string for Clay compatibility and coerced to boolean at runtime.
